slides.title: Own a Laval plex? Read your 2026 tax bill
slides.sub: Five lines that shape your yearly costs, from Auteuil to Laval-Ouest.

photo.credit: Laval City Hall, Chomedey · Photo: Jean-Philippe Boulet, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Under 6 units, or 6 and up?
slides.body: Go from five units to six and Laval's general tax rate jumps about **33%** per $100 of value.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval 2026 budget, January 2026

slides.title: Water is billed per dwelling

photo.credit: Station d'eau potable Chomedey · Photo: Laurent Bélanger, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: The water service charge is **$486 per dwelling** in 2026, up from $337. A triplex pays $1,458.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval 2026 budget, January 2026

slides.title: Two smaller lines follow value
slides.body: Both grow with your assessed value. Buildings with 6+ units pay more: **$0.1100** and **$0.0148**.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval 2026 budget, January 2026

slides.title: Example: a triplex valued at $900K
slides.body: About **$6,776 a year** to the city. Your building's real assessed value sets the actual bill.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval 2026 rates, January 2026

slides.title: Changes spread over 3 years
slides.body: Laval phases in value changes across its **2025–2027** assessment roll. Check the roll before you budget.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval 2026 budget, January 2026
